title: Remove Heat Overlay
description: Removes the Heat overlay inside of hotairballons from create: aeronautics, that can sometimes cause issues with shaders.
body:
This project removes the Heat overlay inside of hotairballons from create: aeronautics, that can sometimes cause issues with shaders.

Shaders are not supported just yet but unfortunatly for some, the natural un-shaded look of minecraft isnt compatable with the retnas, and instead of haveing to listen to them complain i deceded to make a hacky fix to the problem and share it.
